title: Bad Bunny's Two Hiram Bithorn Homecoming Shows Sell Out in Under 6 Hours
detail: Tickets for Bad Bunny's two "Debí Tirar Más Fotos – Cerramos en Casa" closing shows at Estadio Hiram Bithorn (Aug 22–23) went on sale at 10:00 a.m. local time via PRticket.com and sold out completely within six hours. More than 1 million users joined the virtual queue at launch; by 3:00 p.m. organizers warned over 80% of capacity was gone, and by roughly 4:00 p.m. both nights were confirmed sold out. The rush mirrors the demand seen for Bad Bunny's sold-out 2025 Coliseo residency and underscores the frenzy around his homecoming close to the record-breaking, $467.5M-grossing Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour.
